environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private VPC subnet. The Flask proxy container (port 5000) is exposed via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) on TCP port 443 with TLS termination. The NLB passes raw TCP to the container. Backend service at 10.0.1.50:8080 is an HTTP/1.1 server (gunicorn) that processes pipelined requests. No request inspection or header normalization between NLB and container. Task definition uses default Fargate capabilities.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener, no HTTP-level inspection
config.backend: gunicorn HTTP/1.1 with keep-alive and pipelining enabled
